scope: every (split, scene, frame, cav) identity in validate + test + culver
why: A collision is a SILENT failure: two identities share a seed, products stay deterministic, every other check passes, and two frames point orders become correlated. At 32 bits and ~18k identities the birthday probability is a few per cent, so this is enumerated rather than assumed.
remedy_if_nonzero: SHA-256 first 16 bytes -> 4 uint32 -> RandomState (2^128 seed space, still MT19937). NOT per-case salting: that turns a rule into a table of exceptions.
